title: E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling
description:
arXiv:2610.36011v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models.
